description: Admin UI surface for revoking or extending attestations. Must include: attestation list (server_name, verdict, issued_at, expires_at), revoke button (writes to audit_log), extend validity action. Ports to localhost:8790. Reads via write_service :8772 /query mcp_attestations, writes via :8772/write. Each revoke action must insert audit_log row per section 7 security requirement.
